name: John Cena's Sexy High School Adventure
source:
Fucco-san has had enough of being bullied, so he hopes that in his new school, he'll make lots of friends! Will he be the most popular student? Can he make it in time for prom?

[From [url=http://lazlo319.itch.io/john-cena-vn]Itch.io[/url]]
